input.content:
Describe a site. Get a real app. Publish it free.

Kodely is a free AI website builder: you describe what you want in a chat box, and Kodely writes an actual Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 app to match — real component files, not a locked-down template. You watch it render in a live preview as it's built, then publish it to a public URL with one click. No hosting bill, no separate deploy step, no credit card to start.

Sign up and you get 750 free credits immediately — enough for a first real build, which typically runs 100-150 credits.

How it works

1. Describe your site

Tell Kodely what you're building in plain English — a portfolio, a landing page, a small business site. Every project starts from a real foundation: hand-built UI primitives (Button, Card, Section, Nav) that Kodely composes and extends to match your description, not a generic theme with your text dropped in.

2. Watch it build, then keep talking

The live preview shows the actual compiled app as Kodely writes it. Not happy with a section, or want to add one? Describe the change in chat and Kodely edits the real components — no rebuilding from scratch. Every successful generation is saved as a checkpoint, so you can roll back to any earlier version for free if a change goes the wrong direction.

3. Publish, free

One click puts your site live at <yourname>.kodely.site — publishing is free and included, not a paid add-on and not a separate hosting product to configure. There's no custom domain support yet, so your site lives on a kodely.site subdomain for now.

What makes it worth trusting with a real build

  • You can see the actual code. Kodely isn't a black box — open code view at any time to read and copy the real generated source files behind your app.
  • Publishing is free, permanently. Getting your site onto a public URL isn't metered or gated behind a plan — it's included at every tier, from the free 750 credits up.
  • You're never charged for a build that doesn't work. If a generation fails to compile, Kodely automatically attempts one repair. If it still fails, you don't pay for it — credits are metered from real AI cost, not spent on broken output.
  • Every publish is scanned for leaked secrets. Before a site goes live, Kodely checks it for accidentally-exposed API keys or credentials, so a careless prompt doesn't turn into a public leak.

Pricing: start free, top up only if you need to

Kodely's free tier gives you 750 credits on signup, no credit card required — enough to build and publish a first site without paying anything. Credits are metered from real AI usage, so simple builds cost less and complex, multi-step ones cost more.

When you need more, top-ups never expire:

  • $9 for 500 credits
  • $40 for 2,500 credits (most popular)
  • $90 for 6,000 credits

See full details on the pricing page.

Who this is for

Kodely fits best if you want a real, working front-end site fast, without hand-writing React and Tailwind yourself: portfolios, landing pages, small business and event sites, and quick prototypes you want to see live and share a link to today. It's chat-driven, not a drag-and-drop or click-to-edit canvas — you steer changes by describing them, and Kodely rewrites the components behind the scenes.

It's not the right fit yet if your site needs a backend, a database, user accounts, or payments — Kodely currently generates the front end only. It's also not a fit if you need a custom domain today, since published sites live on a kodely.site subdomain.

FAQ

Is Kodely actually free?

Yes. You get 750 credits on signup with no credit card required, and publishing your site to a public kodely.site URL is free and included, not a paid feature. You only pay if you run out of credits and choose to top up.

What do I actually get — a template or real code?

Real code. Kodely generates an actual Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 project with real component files, built from hand-built UI primitives and your description — not a template with placeholder text swapped in. You can open code view in-app to read and copy the generated source at any time.

Can I download my project?

Not yet. You can view and copy the generated source files from code view inside Kodely, but there's no full-project zip export or download yet.

Do I get charged if a build fails?

No. Kodely automatically attempts one repair if a generation fails to compile. If it still doesn't work, you're not charged for it.

Can I use my own domain?

Not yet — published sites are live at a free <yourname>.kodely.site URL. Custom domain support isn't available yet.

Does Kodely build the backend too — database, login, payments?

Not currently. Kodely generates the front-end app — components, layout, and styling. Backend, database, authentication, and payment integration aren't part of what it generates today.

How do edits work after the first build?

The same way the first build did: describe the change you want in chat, and Kodely edits the real components to match. There's no visual click-to-edit canvas — it's chat-based throughout. Every successful generation is a free checkpoint you can roll back to.

Build your first site free

Describe what you want, watch it come together in a live preview, and publish it to a real public URL — all without spending anything. Sign up free and get 750 credits to start, or log in if you already have an account. Want to see more of what Kodely can do first? Check the blog or head back to the homepage.
